name: Phallus impudicus
notes: Thick white cords lead to "eggs" that expand in hours; flies carry the spores. Extension rate rises with temperature from 5 to 20 C [14], but the numeric rates were not obtained.

tip_speed.note: Claude's inference from the species' ecology and general knowledge, not from a measurement (2026-11-10): forms long cords from buried wood; a little below the family's type species

uptake_rate.note: tuning value, set to tip speed / segment length so that one feeding segment can supply about one growing tip; no measurement found
